summary.zh: 为会面或尽调准备公司个人档案
summary.en: Build decision-grade dossiers on a company or person for meetings.

description.zh: 研究指定的公司、个人或机构，用正反两面的证据检验你给出的判断，输出一份可交付的尽调档案。适合重要会面前做功课、投资尽调或合作方背景核查时使用。需要联网检索，成品为 .docx 文档。
description.en: Researches a specific company, person or organisation, tests your stated hypothesis against balanced evidence and delivers a .docx dossier. Useful before important meetings, investor diligence or partner checks. Needs web access.
